title: 6Sense Filter
subtitle: Six-dimensional qualification screening evaluating Direction, Energy (CLV:CAC ≥ 3:1), Capacity, Prioritisation, Risk (EMV models), and Decision governance.

sections.heading: The 6-Dimensional Qualification Architecture
sections.body: The 6Sense Filter™ evaluates ventures across six operational pillars: Direction, Energy (CLV:CAC ≥ 3:1), Capacity (OEE & CCC metrics), Prioritisation, Risk (Expected Monitory Value models), and Decision Governance. Decision capability holds absolute veto power — ensuring strategic alignment before capital deployment.

sections.heading: Regulated Domain De-risking
sections.body: Traditional venture frameworks fail in high-barrier industries. 6Sense embeds compliance, cybersecurity, and data architecture requirements directly into early-stage evaluation, turning regulatory constraints into durable competitive moats.
